animation_sequence.text: Exodus 12:17“Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread, because it was onthis very day that I brought your  divisions out of Egypt.Celebrate this day as a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

It is not a coincidence that Jesus and his disciples are about to eatthe Passover meal, which marks the day Israel was freed from Egypt.Spiritually Christ is soon set everyone free. He himself will become"our Passover lamb"  which marks our exodus from the world. The Passover rules specified that the 10th day the lamb would be taken. Christ during this meal identifies Judas who will betrayJesus and hand him over to be "taken."Before He is taken, Jesus, the Lamb of God, inaugurates the newmeal which Christians eat in remembrance of Him – which also signifies an exodus from an old life to a new.
